cases.title: After an Edit Pipe cascade from P3 with U and REDO, CDSYNC warns first, relinks 11 pits and 49 pipes, and every Pit Schedule row and cell reads exactly as before it
cases.plan_item: CDSYNC keeps the schedule (gap plan section 3 item 7; card C42 assertions 1 and 2 with the cascade preparation; with R13 the whole named check)
cases.expected: Edit Pipe on 10A98D with 17.60 / 17.50, Recalculate Yes and Apply say 'Updated 4 pipes and 3 pits from P3 (IL 17.50)'; one U echoes CDEDIT; after 12 s REDO says 'Everything has been redone'. The Pit Schedule then shows P3 with inlet 17.50 and outlet 17.45. CDSYNC prints its one-line warning, then 'CDSYNC complete. Pits relinked: 11, Pipes relinked: 49'; the object count does not change; the Civil log holds one 'Command outcome: CDSYNC completed'; the Pit Schedule read again equals the one read before CDSYNC, row for row and cell for cell.
cases.why_not_unit: CDSYNC must reconcile the real drawing objects with the stored records after a real cascade, and the schedule shows those records live.
not_automated: The schedule header (issue count, BUG-855) is not compared or recorded: only the grid rows and cells. C42's 12 / 50 counts belong to the SETUP-R47 drawing; this fresh drawing asserts its own 11 / 49.
U after CDSYNC is not driven here (R13 drives it).
